meta.name: editor-perf
meta.description: Guides performance investigation, benchmarking, and optimization of the Grida Canvas web editor (TypeScript reducer, Immer, React hooks). Use when profiling reducer dispatch cost, diagnosing slow interactions (drag, resize, color change), writing or running editor benchmarks, instrumenting with PerfObserver, or optimizing the JS-side state management pipeline.

copy.tagline: 分析并优化编辑器性能瓶颈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发或维护一个复杂的 Web 编辑器，需要诊断和优化其交互性能。
copy.tagline_en: Profile and optimize editor performance bottlenecks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析 Grida Canvas 编辑器的性能问题，比如拖拽卡顿、颜色修改慢等。它会指导你使用浏览器性能工具、运行基准测试或添加性能监控代码，并给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当你需要排查编辑器交互卡顿（如拖拽、缩放、颜色修改），或者想运行基准测试、添加性能监控时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下这个浏览器性能追踪文件，看看哪里卡顿。
运行编辑器的基准测试，看看 reducer 的性能。
我想在代码里添加性能监控，测量 dispatch 的耗时。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you analyze performance issues in the Grida Canvas editor, such as laggy drag, resize, or color changes. It guides you in using browser performance tools, running benchmarks, or adding performance instrumentation, and provides optimization advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to diagnose slow editor interactions (drag, resize, color change), run benchmarks, or add performance monitoring.

say_en.text: Analyze this browser performance trace file and tell me where the bottleneck is.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the .json.gz trace and identify main-thread bottlenecks.

say_en.text: Run the editor benchmarks to check reducer performance.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to run perf-editor.test.ts and interpret the report.

say_en.text: I want to add performance monitoring to measure dispatch time.
say_en.note: Claude will show you how to use PerfObserver's start/measure methods.
